subject: Proposal: escrowed credits & action plan for last week's latency incidents
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.g@clearsky.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: eng@clearsky.ai
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Severe latency spikes Aug 7-8 — request for remediation and credits

Rishi,

Thanks for taking a look — the ClearSky platform experienced repeated 504s and 2-3s tail latency spikes across several inference endpoints during Wed/Thu (Aug 7-8). Our customers saw degraded search relevance and two transactional jobs failed overnight. We raised a support ticket but the intermittent nature made troubleshooting tricky.

We need two things: 1) a summary of what happened (root cause / mitigation) and 2) a proposal for making ClearSky whole on the customer side — token credits or a trial extension for impacted teams so we can preserve our demos and SLOs.

Attaching the incident extracts and a couple of screenshots. Open to a conversation today if helpful.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Director of Platform Ops
ClearSky Analytics

Attachments: incident_log_2026-08-07.csv (CSV), screenshot-504s.png (image)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.g@clearsky.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes Aug 7-8 — request for remediation and credits

Maria — thanks for the note and for the logs. I’m sorry ClearSky hit instability last week. We’ve triaged the traces and there are two overlapping causes: an autoscaler misconfiguration that briefly allowed request queues to grow, and a model kernel fallback that increased token latency under a particular request mix. Both were transient and we pushed hotfixes last night.

Next steps I propose:
- We’ll send a short incident summary by EOD that includes timeline + mitigations.
- For immediate relief, Redwood will issue a temporary pool of escrowed credits equivalent to four days of average consumption for the impacted routes (to buy your teams more demo / QA time).
- Follow-up: our SRE will work with your eng lead to validate the fix and adjust autoscaler thresholds.

I’m looping in Marissa (customer success) and Stephanie (sales ops) to confirm the credit size and any commercial approvals. David from SRE is on the thread for the technical follow-up.

Would a 30-day trial extension plus the escrowed credit pool be sufficient as a start?

—Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: proposed-credit-memo.pdf (draft)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Maria Gonzalez <maria.g@clearsky.ai>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes Aug 7-8 — request for remediation and credits

Thanks Rishi — I’ve reviewed the usage patterns and drafted a conservative remediation offer in the attached memo. Summary: 1) Escrowed credits equal to 120k tokens (roughly 4 days of average production usage for your routes) 2) 30-day trial extension for any teams impacted by the incident 3) One complimentary health-check call with our SREs to validate autoscaler settings.

Notes / approvals:
- This is within the pre-approved ‘‘incident gestures’’ spend for deals under $250k ARR; no additional finance sign-off required.
- If ClearSky prefers a one-time invoice credit instead of token credits, we can convert at your list rate; that would require a quick billing approval (I can loop in Alex if needed).

Maria — I attached the proposed-credit-memo.pdf. If that looks good I’ll route for final sign-off and have Stephanie issue the credits.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed-credit-memo.pdf (PDF)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Maria Gonzalez <maria.g@clearsky.ai>, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-09T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes Aug 7-8 — request for remediation and credits

Confirmed — finance has the memo in the workflow. Two quick operational items before I push credits out:
1) Please confirm the target entitlement scope: do we credit the account org-wide or only the impacted route IDs?
2) Please confirm whether ClearSky wants token credits (default) or a billed invoice credit.

If org-wide, I’ll issue credits to the ClearSky account and set an expiration of 90 days; if route-limited, we’ll apply a tag to the credit so it only consumes against the recorded endpoints.

Maria — what would you prefer? If you don’t have a preference, we typically do route-limited token credits for troubleshooting and org-wide only for broader service failures.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.g@clearsky.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-10T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes Aug 7-8 — request for remediation and credits

Team — thank you. Route-limited token credits with a 90-day window sound perfect; that lets us preserve credit for the specific affected production routes while we validate the fix.

Two items before you finalize:
- Please include a short line in the credit memo that the gesture is issued in recognition of the Aug 7-8 interruptions and does not constitute admission of broader SLA failure. Our legal team asked for the wording for their records.
- We’d like the SRE health-check call next Tuesday (Aug 17) at 10am PT — David, can your team confirm availability?

If that all works, please proceed and send the credit code and memo to billing@clearsky.ai. Appreciate the quick coordination.

Best,
Maria
Director of Platform Ops
ClearSky Analytics
